issue.body_normalized:
## Description

The `ReactiveToolbar` overwrites the `insertRelative()` method from the `Toolbar` to handle the case where the relative item is in the popup opener (see https://github.com/jupyterlab/jupyterlab/pull/15553).

It uses a `_widgetPositions` map to get the position of the relative item. The `_widgetPositions` map keeps the expected position of each item, whether it is in the toolbar or in the popup opener.

Therefore, the `_widgetPosition` needs to be up to date, but is not updated when an item is removed from the toolbar (only when a widget is added).

## Reproduce

Open a Notebook as main widget and in the console:
```js
// Get the Notebook toolbar
toolbar = jupyterapp.shell.currentWidget.toolbar
// Get the 'run' item
runItem = toolbar.layout.widgets[Array.from(toolbar.names()).indexOf('run')]
// Remove the 'run' item
runItem.dispose()
// Reinsert the 'run' item before the 'interrupt' item (same as startup)
toolbar.insertBefore('interrupt', 'run', runItem)

// The 'run' item is inserted after the 'interrupt' item because the index of the 'interrupt' item
// has not been updated, and its index is +1 from the real index.
```

## Expected behavior

The button to be inserted at the correct position

## Context

Seen in jupyter-chat, which uses a reactive toolbar with relative insertion in the side panel https://github.com/jupyterlab/jupyter-chat/blob/18d052f7345169b867c764fbe42d36afa04e41e2/packages/jupyter-chat/src/widgets/multichat-panel.tsx#L619
